name: v2.11-11200
body:
QuestSoundBits is a quest progress sound alert addon.  
It will play short Peon (Horde players) or Peasant (Alliance players) voice clips when the player 
- Completes a Quest
- Completes a Quest Objective
- Progresses a Quest Objective  
  Each kind of alert can be toggled ON or OFF. 

**/questsoundbits**, **/questsounds** or **/qsb** for command-line help  
Addon makes an effort not to play overlapping sounds when events happen at the same time _(eg. Last or single quest objective completes and that completes the quest)_  
It will instead play the higher priority alert (Quest completion over Objective completion over Objective Progress).

2.11 Changelog
Tweak quest completion caching and improve handling quest acquire/abandon at start of play session causing false positives.  
Add a better quality Job's Done sound.
